content: Docker compose rollback pattern: simplest automatable approach is editing the image: tag line in docker-compose.yml (regex/yaml replace) to point at the previous known-good tag, then running 'docker compose up -d' to recreate only the changed service. Community examples mostly describe manual docker tag/docker image rm flows; no widely-established Python library for this -- expect to hand-roll a small subprocess wrapper (subprocess.run(['docker','compose','up','-d'], cwd=..., check=True, timeout=...)) plus yaml read/write via PyYAML, and to capture the previous tag before mutating so rollback-of-rollback is possible.
